name: Language Rearrangement
description: Language Rearrangement is a benchmark for language-conditioned embodied AI tasks, consisting of 150,000 training and 1,000 testing tasks that require models to interpret language instructions and perform rearrangement actions in a visual environment.
reputation: Released to aid research in language-conditioned, multi-task embodied AI; enables evaluation of generalization to unseen tasks.
notes: Benchmark includes large-scale training and testing sets; focuses on rearrangement tasks with language instructions.
